answer: Bindings are kept in dawn, verified in vault, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the reef check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 555 identities would post 837 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
